body:
Thank you all for attending today! Here are the notes from this meeting (the next one is at https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10094):

### Agenda  
Attendees: Fernando Serboncini, Olli Pettay, Jean-Philippe Gravel, Mason Freed, Khushal Sagar, Vladimir Levin, Di Zhang, Domenic Denicola, Dan Clark, Chris Harrelson, Shu-Yu Guo, Joey Arhar, Panos Astithas, Marcos Caceres, Chris Wilson, Michael Smith

1. Review past action items
    1. Anne will add WebKit feedback (or find someone to do so) on [Don't clip range/checkbox/radio overflow to border box](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10025).
        1. Done.
    1. Anne will follow up on [`<button>` and user selection](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8228) with the WebKit engineers.
        1. Marcos will follow up with WebKit engineers.
    1. Mason will prototype the agreed solution for [Opening a dialog as modal, nested inside a popover, causes the whole page to go inert with limited ways for the user to address it](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9998).
        1. Work has [started](https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromium/src/+/5229300).
        1. Domenic points out that there are a few popover spec PRs that are under review that should be prioritized.
            1. [https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9457](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9457) [needs rebasing, has discussion with Igalia but Domenic is unclear on conclusion]
            1. [https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9387](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9387) [domenic just pinged now]
            1. [https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10015](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10015) [got a response yesterday]
    1. Emilio will propose a new spec PR and test for [User interacted flag gets set when change events are set, but tests disagree](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10013).
        1. In progress ([https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10067](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10067))
    1. Sanket will follow up internally to find someone to present [A way to disable animation of cancelled drag for editor apps like VS Code](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10039) at a future meeting.
        1. Dan will follow up internally.
    1. Sanket will update the [New attribute to control UA-provided writing assistance](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9065) PR to behave the same as spellcheck.
        1. [PR](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/10018) was updated. Olli asks for more work around styling the suggestions. Consensus in the room to try to land what we have and follow up with additional PRs.
    1. Olli will discuss performance with Henri for [[View Transitions] Extend render-blocking to support Document](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/9332).
        1. Done. It does affect page load performance. Investigating what could be done there. Discussed not emitting a closing tag signal but bundling it with the next opening tag.
        1. Marcos pinged a few people internally. 
        1. Vlad asks people to chime in to settle the naming issue of the attribute.
1. Carryovers from last time
    1. Simon to look more into nested interactive content spec behavior, with synthetic click events.
        1. Carry over.
    1. [Anne] [Add `&nnbsp;` entity for `U+202F`](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/5121)
        1. Carryover till February 22 along with the other [tagged issues](https://github.com/w3c/i18n-activity/labels/Agenda%2BI18N%2BWHATWG).
1. New topics
    1. [Di] [Rendering `<input type=range>` vertically](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4177) and [Clarify value direction for elements "progress" and "meter" with vertical writing mode](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8413)
        1. Di to send a spec PR to update [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-range-control](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-range-control) and [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-progress-element-2](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-progress-element-2) and [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-meter-element-2](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-meter-element-2) with at least the same level of detail.
    1. [Jean-Philippe] [Add a layer and filter interface in the 2D canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9537)
        1. Marcos will follow up with heycam on WebKit's opinion. 
        1. Particularly interested in more opinions on the question raised at [https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8476#issuecomment-1826735392](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8476#issuecomment-1826735392)
        1. Olli will follow up internally to see if Gecko's stance is still "neutral" to this proposal.
    1. [Marcos] [Allowing UA to do `<source>` selection for media element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10077)
        1. Domenic asked for some data on the benefits and will get an internal Chromium position. Marcos will follow up with jyavenard to see if there is data on efficiency that they can share. Simon will get the Gecko position on this.
    1. [Shu] Seeking feedback on [mini waits on the main thread](https://github.com/syg/proposal-atomics-microwait)
        1. No strong objections from anyone in the room. Shu will bring it up with TC39 for further discussions.

### Action Items

1. @marcoscaceres will follow up with WebKit engineers on [`<button>` and user selection](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/8228).
1. @dandclark will follow up internally to find someone to present [A way to disable animation of cancelled drag for editor apps like VS Code](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10039) at a future meeting.
1. @dizhang168 to send a spec PR to update [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-range-control](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-input-element-as-a-range-control) and [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-progress-element-2](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-progress-element-2) and [https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-meter-element-2](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/rendering.html#the-meter-element-2) with at least the same level of detail.
1. @marcoscaceres will follow up with @heycam on WebKit's opinion on [Add a layer and filter interface in the 2D canvas](https://github.com/whatwg/html/pull/9537). @smaug---- will follow up internally to see if Gecko's stance is still "neutral" to this proposal.
1. @domenic will get an internal Chromium position for [Allowing UA to do `<source>` selection for media element](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10077). @marcoscaceres will follow up with @jyavenard to see if there is any data on efficiency that they can share. @zcorpan will get the Gecko position on it.
